description: Election calendar used by server/window.ts. Times are Asia/Kolkata; a date-only value means the start of that day (IST). Blackout is [mccStart, end): end is the first instant the window is over. Only entries with verified:true and without example:true count, and only inside [coveredFrom, coveredThrough); outside that range the state is unknown (fail closed). Never invent dates: copy from the ECI/SEC schedule and cite the source URL.

examples.label: EXAMPLE ONLY - not a real election
